info.name: Suggest the required fielding time for a target group

items.docs: Suggests the optimal number of days required to field a target group based on its specifications. You can use this endpoint to estimate fielding time before creating a target group. You'll need to provide details like the locale, price, length of interview (LOI), incidence rate (IR), and desired number of completes.

info.name: Suggests an optimal fielding time range for a locale

params.name: days
params.description: The number of days to field the target group. Use this parameter OR both `start` and `end`.

params.name: start
params.description: The start date for the fielding window (RFC3339 format). Use this parameter in conjunction with `end`, OR only use `days`.

params.name: end
params.description: The end date for the fielding window (RFC3339 format). Use this parameter in conjunction with `start`, OR only use `days`.

items.docs:
Suggests an optimal time range to field a target group in a specific locale, taking into account local holidays and respondent activity patterns.

How to specify a time range:

* To get a suggestion for a specific duration starting from now, provide the `days` parameter.
* To get a suggestion within a specific date window, provide both the `start` and `end` parameters.
